question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'fine birds'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the fourth blank is **'fine birds'.**
 
• The sentence implies that the quality of a man is not determined by the quality of his clothes, as **fine feathers (or expensive clothing) **do not make the man. Therefore, the correct option to fill in the blank would be** "fine birds."**
 
• Example: Just as a peacock's feathers may be beautiful, but do not determine the worth or character of the bird, expensive clothing does not determine the worth or character of a person.
 
• **Option 1 - "Falter birds"** doesn't make sense in the given context, as it doesn't relate to the idea of determining the worth or character of a person.
 
 
• Example: If a bird is weak or injured, it may **falter **when it tries to fly.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - "Finest birds" **implies a superlative degree of quality, but it doesn't fit in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: The** finest birds** may have the most beautiful feathers or the sweetest songs.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - "Finer birds" **also implies a comparative degree of quality, but it doesn't fit in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example:** Finer birds** may have better quality feathers or be more rare than other birds.
 
 
 
• So, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 4 is **"fine birds."
